Stepper buttons lacked event handlers to increment and decrement key register and animation speed inputs.

Synchronized live telemetry readouts during smooth pH lerp so that pOH and [H3O+] consistently satisfy water autoionization equilibrium at every rendered frame.
Added event handling for stepper increment/decrement buttons to guarantee input responsiveness across all browsers.
